pages.text: $(li)$(item)Hazmat Helmet$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Hazmat Suit$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Hazmat Pants$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Hazmat Boots$()$(br)The Hazmat Suit is bright yellow protective armor against $(l:nuclear/radiation)radiation$(/l). Wear it near nuclear waste, a leaking reactor or a meltdown site.

Each piece keeps out $(l)25%$() of the radiation; the $(l)full suit$() keeps out all of it.$(br)$(li)$(l)0$(): 0%, 100 Rad$(br)$(li)$(l)1$(): 25%, 75 Rad$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): 50%, 50 Rad$(br)$(li)$(l)3$(): 75%, 25 Rad$(br)$(li)$(l)4$(): $(l)100%$(), 0 Rad$(br)$(li)Against everything else it is weak armor: 1 (helmet), 3 (suit), 2 (pants) and 1 (boots) armor points.
pages.title: Protection

pages.text: $(li)Any piece also keeps out the cold of $(l:nuclear/coolant)coolant pools$(/l) and powder snow.$(br)$(li)A $(l:nuclear/geiger_counter)Geiger Counter$(/l) tells you how much radiation there is.
